ns2:course.label: Music Teaching in Ensemble Settings
ns2:course.description: Emphasizing the collaborative nature of teaching and learning, this team-taught, comprehensive course engages students in teaching music through school ensembles of all kinds. Topics include comprehensive musicianship, creativity and composition, instructional planning, management structures and routines, and inclusive practices in music education. Prerequisite: MUS 240 and MUS 342 or MUS 343; or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 240 and MUS 342 or MUS 343; or consent of instructor.
